text:
kara: kicking off deploy v1.14.0 now. starting staggered FF rollout for smart-routing (key: ff.smart_routing.v2) at 1% — rolling cohorts. release notes draft at PR #411.
deploy-bot: [bot] rollout started: ff.smart_routing.v2 -> 1% (cohort: gradual-top10). job id=rb-202306-88
matt: quick confirm — are we pinning model binary to sha `abc123def` for this cohort? want to avoid surprise variant.
kara: yes pinned to abc123def in routing config. only unpin after 100% and verification.
sasha: monitoring dashboards now. watch p50/p95/p99 + token cost diffs. :eyes:
ana: adding explicit rollback gates here: immediate rollback if 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 2m OR p99 latency increases >25ms vs baseline for 3 consecutive windows.
kevin: add quality gate too: if eval metric (response-coherence) drops >3% on the smoke prompt set, trigger flag-off and rollback.
matt: schedule for ramp: 1% -> 5% at +10m -> 25% at +30m -> 100% at +2h. anyone object?
sasha: that schedule works. will alert if p95 jumps >10ms at any step.
kara: note the guard rails: we will not proceed to 100% if any automated check fails. manual override only by oncall + release lead.
ana: runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/feature-flag-rollouts (contains exact commands to flip flags and drain connections)
matt: flag names to use in ops commands: `ff.smart_routing.v2` and `ff.smart_routing.v2.force_unpin` (force_unpin used only in emergency rollback flows)
kevin: if rollback, sequence: 1) set ff.smart_routing.v2 -> off 2) run `deploy rollback v1.14.0` 3) drain new routings 4) postmortem template filled within 4h.
sasha: observing p95 +8ms at 1% after warmup. token cost per request stable.
kara: good. plan to shift to 5% in 10m unless we see any alerts. I'll paste a short snippet for release notes: "smart routing v2: incremental rollout, pinned model for canary, improved per-request cost and latency tradeoffs." 
matt: also add a note about pinning and how to unpin safely.
deploy-bot: [bot] scheduled traffic shift: 1% -> 5% in 9m (job id rb-202306-89)
sasha: no anomalies during sampling. will post stats at +15m.
kara: thanks all — once we hit 25% and stable for 30m I'll mark the PR for final publish and update the release notes.
deploy-bot: [bot] milestone: rollout reached 25% at 2307654560 (job id rb-202306-90).
